results.title: Emraan Hashmi net worth: Inside the ‘Awarapan 2’ actor's Rs 105 crore empire
results.description: Emraan Hashmi's net worth stands at Rs 105 crore, driven by film fees and brand deals. He owns properties in Goa, Bandra, and Lonavala, plus luxury cars like a Lamborghini and Range Rover. Next up: 'Awarapan 2' with Disha Patani, releasing August 14, clashing with 'Batwara 1947'.
